description: This file defines a Java interface for a Feign client that communicates with the core banking service to perform account reading and fund transfer operations, specifically through REST API endpoints.

classes.name: BankingCoreFeignClient
classes.description: A Java interface annotated with @FeignClient to declare REST client methods for interacting with the core banking service.

methods.name: readAccount
methods.description: Retrieves account information for a given account number by calling the corresponding REST API endpoint.

methods.name: fundTransfer
methods.description: Performs a fund transfer operation by sending a request to the core banking service's transfer API.
